title: JMAP upload: POST /jmap/upload/{accountId}/ handler
description: Implement POST /jmap/upload/{accountId}/ accepting application/octet-stream or message/rfc822 body. Parse as RFC 5322 article. Validate headers (Newsgroups, Subject, From, Message-ID). Run through write_article_to_ipfs(). Return {accountId, blobId: <CID>, type: message/rfc822, size}. Error responses: 400 invalid, 413 oversized, 503 IPFS unavailable. Blocked on: stoa-36f405ad.
